reviewer: Second native GPT-6.1 Sol reviewer; arranged physics/browser assessment, not a human participant
build: Build10 final movement followups: narrowed grate support, per-mesh barricades, torso melee/supply range and Space ribbon

ratings.reason: Stable cover landing adds a concrete optional movement affordance. The fixed-frame fixtures establish support and collision behavior, not a broader increase in enjoyment, discovery, content depth or fidelity; the same provisional rubric scores remain appropriate. The actual elevated screenshots retain a readable target area and industrial scene, but simple character/weapon animation, a shared courtyard and limited authored encounters remain far below AAA production scope.

methods: Installed Google Chrome headless, Playwright, actual Three.js/WebGL at1280x800 with SwiftShader. All positions, enemy arrangements and synthetic ceiling are explicit fixtures.

Controlled requestAnimationFrame; normal canvas keydown Space plus movement key sets and direct game updates at known simulation intervals. These are deterministic physics fixtures, not continuous natural gameplay.

Actual vent approach used x14,z12.5, W for0.5seconds and Space, then released input. Final eye height3.015m means feet1.315m on visible grate. Five further simulated seconds retained support; walking right off the vent returned to floor.

Inspected both actual grate and raised phase screenshots using view_image. Browser closed after fixture execution. Screenshot HUD time can remain stale because these fixtures render directly rather than using natural RAF/HUD update timing.

Initial projectile fixture ran while asynchronously pointer-lock-paused and therefore correctly applied no damage; fixture now explicitly sets playing before its arranged damage check. This fixture correction is not a product defect.
Reran all nine browser checks against final parent followups and re-inspected both regenerated actual screenshots. All nine checks passed; no uncaught browser exceptions.

findings.recommendation: Add a concise Space/jump hint or platform approach cue without crowding target sightlines.
findings.resolution: Parent added SPACE JUMP; inspected final1280x800 screenshots show it without target overlap.

findings.resolution: Parent narrowed continuous grate tox±1.91, aligned strict radius predicate and used separate actual mesh bounds for barricade parts. Actual vent approach/rest/walkoff and pillar/bounds dash rechecks pass.

limitations: No full mission or unarranged combat play in this reviewer; the separate normal-control reviewer covers that distinct evidence scope.
No blind human learning, enjoyment, auditory judgment, hardware performance certification, broad accessibility study or AAA readiness claim.
Ceiling and vertical recovery fixtures use synthetic boxes because reachable mission paths have no low ceilings or high platforms.
Bounding boxes remain conservative envelopes for rotated props, not full mesh collision; support edges and jump timing can still need further real play refinement.
No exhaustive fuzz search over all rotated prop seams or all landing angles; conservative Box3 mesh bounds remain for architecture and barricade parts.
